title: SharePoint integration
summary: Connect SharePoint to Parachute. Bring files into your matters, work on them with the AI, and save them back as new versions.
body_markdown:
If your firm keeps its documents in SharePoint, Parachute now connects to it directly.


## Bring files in


- Browse your firm’s SharePoint sites, document libraries and folders from inside Parachute.
- Import files into a matter, your knowledge base or your precedents.
- Attach a SharePoint file in chat, or ask Parachute to find one for you.


## Save your work back


Save a document you’ve worked on back to SharePoint and it’s recorded as a new version of the same file, so SharePoint stays your system of record. New documents can go to any library or folder.


## Enabling it


A firm admin connects SharePoint once, under Firm settings > Integrations. Everyone in your organisation then sees the sites and files the connecting account can access.


[Full setup guide in the docs](https://help.goparachute.ai/integrations/sharepoint/)
